modules.title: 一串类名，怎样变成卡片外观？
类名怎样变成页面样式

items.title: 直接对应 CSS 属性
items.text: 每个工具类名就像一句微型指令，直接控制留白、排版等单一属性。例如 p-4 对应内边距 1rem，text-lg 对应较大的字号。

items.title: 响应式前缀控制断点
items.text: 通过添加 md:、lg: 或 sm: 前缀，可以指定样式在哪些屏幕尺寸下生效，从而在 HTML 里直接完成响应式设计。

items.title: 状态变体控制交互
items.text: 使用 hover:、focus: 或 dark: 变体，可以让元素在特定交互或主题下改变外观，无需写复杂的选择器。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 看到很长的一串类名时，先按“留白、文字、边框、布局”分组读；重复出现的整串样式应收进组件。

lessonPractice.title: 给卡片加入一段更长的说明后，文字显得拥挤，离卡片边缘很近。应该先改哪类 Tailwind 类名？

options.label: 控制内边距的 p-* 类名
options.feedback: 对。内容与卡片边缘的距离由 padding 控制，p-* 正是在调整内边距。

options.label: 控制外边距的 m-* 类名
options.feedback: 外边距会改变卡片与邻居的距离，不能增加内容与自身边缘之间的空间。

options.label: 控制圆角的 rounded-* 类名
options.feedback: rounded-* 只改变角的形状，不会把内容从边缘推开。

en.title: After adding longer copy to a card, the text feels cramped against its edges. Which Tailwind utility should you change first?

options.label: A p-* utility that controls padding
options.feedback: Correct. Padding controls the space between content and the card edge, and p-* utilities change that padding.

options.label: An m-* utility that controls outer margin
options.feedback: Outer margin changes the card’s distance from neighbors, not the space between its content and edge.

options.label: A rounded-* utility that controls corner radius
options.feedback: rounded-* changes the corner shape, not the distance between content and the edge.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请只调整这张卡片的 Tailwind 类名，让内容有足够的内边距，同时保留现有圆角和边框。不要改其他组件。改完后分别看桌面和手机尺寸，并告诉我增加或删除了哪些类名。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Adjust only this card's Tailwind classes so the content has enough padding while keeping the existing radius and border. Do not change other components. Check both desktop and mobile afterward, then tell me which classes you added or removed.

learning.assumes: You have seen cards with spacing and borders.
learning.outcome: You can read a few Tailwind classes and identify which change padding, corners, and borders.

modules.title: How do class names become a card?

items.title: Map directly to CSS properties
items.text: Each utility class acts as a micro-instruction controlling a single property. For example, p-4 applies 1rem of padding, and text-lg sets a larger font size.

items.title: Responsive prefixes control breakpoints
items.text: By adding prefixes like md:, lg:, or sm:, you specify at which screen sizes the styles apply, doing responsive design directly in HTML.

items.title: State variants handle interactions
items.text: Using variants like hover:, focus:, or dark: allows elements to change appearance on interaction or theme change without writing complex selectors.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: When a class list is long, group it by spacing, text, borders, and layout. Repeated combinations usually belong in a component.
